text:
Mike L: quick check — after the last infra PR our ExternalSecret template seems to have dropped the rotation TTL annotation. noticed tokens for service-api not refreshing. anyone seen this? :grimacing:
Sara K: yeah i noticed flaky refreshes yesterday, assumed it was the sidecar. which PR number?
Mike L: #4127 (terraform helm values change). in the plan I see this snippet removed from values: `rotation.annotations:
  rotation/ttl: "30m"`
Alex P: pinging infra owners @Sara K @Mike L, can you paste the helm values portion (the externalsecret template) so i can diff? also which cluster? prod or staging?
Mike L: prod. pasted below:
```yaml
externalsecret:
  template:
    metadata:
      annotations:
        rotation/ttl: "30m"
```
Sara K: i think the PR changed `externalsecret.template.metadata` -> `externalsecret.template.commonMeta` (accidental rename). helm rendered without the annotation. i can open a quick fix PR to re-add the field to the new path.
Alex P: ok, if it's a rename then plan + apply will still not add annotation until TF state is updated. short term we can patch the running ExternalSecret to restore rotation. run: `kubectl -n prod patch externalsecret service-api -p '\"{\"metadata\": {\"annotations\": {\"rotation/ttl\": \"30m\"}}}\"' --type=merge`
Mike L: trying patch now...
ops-bot: executed command on cluster-prod at 2026-02-15T14:12:02Z
Mike L: patch succeeded, external secret shows annotation again. will monitor rotation. thanks.
Sara K: i pushed a tiny PR that maps the new `commonMeta` back to `metadata` during template render and includes a test. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4132 :thumbsup:
Alex P: can we add a terraform plan guard so future renames that drop annotations fail CI? maybe a terratest that renders helm and checks for `rotation/ttl` in externalsecret templates.
Sara K: yes i'll add a unit test in the helm chart CI. also added a TODO in the PR description to follow up with a TF state migration if needed.
Mike L: thanks all. leaving a monitoring note to watch token expiry in the next 40m. if rotation doesn't kick, i'll escalate to oncall. :eyes:
deploy-bot: rollout finished for infra-chart (canary) — no changes to runtime replicas.
Mike L: last check — anyone saw a similar rename in other services? i can grep the repo for `commonMeta` but wanted to ask first.
Alex P: i grep'd earlier, only chart `externalsecret` in infra repo had that key change. good catch.
Sara K: i'll run the grep across monorepo later today and post results here.
Mike L: great, thanks. closing thread once CI green on PR 4132.
